authorization_gate.required: Explicit primary message announcing implementation freeze before any fresh search, candidate selection, download or inspection.
receipt_contents: referenced implementation freeze path and hashes

scope.not_required_for_eligibility: Presence of either target field; negative, relative-date, conditional and uncertain cases remain eligible.
scope.labels: Collector stores source metadata only. No extracted answers, expected verdicts or adjudication labels in runtime or manifest.

sampling.assignment: Scan slot takes priority; each notice occupies one slot. Negative/conditional stratum classifications are discovery bookkeeping, not field labels; kept out of pipeline runtime. Eligible source includes absence of an absolute date or email.
sampling.novelty: Reject matching old original PDF SHA256 or same underlying old notice even if URL/bytes changed. Prefer publication/template families absent from dedup inventory. No more than one notice from each new original PDF. New URL or state alone is not family independence.
sampling.family_fallback: If no novel-family scan found in bounded scan queue, allow a fresh original from an old family only with explicit overlap flag and remaining quota rationale; never duplicate old notice.
sampling.selection: First eligible candidate in ordered query/results queue that fills an open stratum and state slot. Record exclusions and duplicates. Stop accepting at12; do not replace accepted notices based on extraction results.
sampling.shortfall: If bounded search cannot fill scan/state/negative/conditional quotas, preserve actual achieved counts and report incomplete design to primary. Do not silently fill scan slots with born-digital forms or synthetic rasters.
sampling.temporal: No requirement that comment period remains open; historical notices eligible. Do not filter by a date or email being easy to extract.

scan_evidence.qualifies: Original publisher PDF whose notice body is image-only, or a genuine scanned/degraded notice with an unreliable embedded OCR layer; visually verify source pages and PDF image/text diagnostics.
does_not_qualify: a signature or stamp image on otherwise born-digital text
a synthetic scan created by rasterizing a digital original
empty pdftotext caused by tool failure or encryption without scan confirmation
retain: native pdftotext output including empty output
per-notice factual scan classification with supporting physical pages
scan_evidence.ambiguity: Count uncertain scan classification separately, not toward the minimum four.

per_source: source URL and final redirected URL
official publisher/discovery URL and discovery linkage
retrieval timestamp including timezone, HTTP status, headers, errors
original.pdf with SHA256 and byte count
input.pdf with SHA256 and derivation provenance if needed
native.txt from unmodified input; native-original.txt when excerpted
page images for every input page
complete notice start/end boundaries and neighboring material
tool versions and exact rendering/extraction commands
retention.standalone_preference: Use full standalone notice PDFs when available. Retain complete original even when a register excerpt is necessary. Never truncate a notice to fit limits.
retention.register_rule: Include every continuation page of the notice and retain whole physical pages; specify named target and boundaries. Do not mask inconvenient neighboring material. Preserve full original and page map. If notice exceeds frozen pipeline limits, log exclusion before any model execution.
retention.manifest: Adapt source-only metadata to the pipeline child published manifest contract once available; do not invent a competing runtime contract.

ledger.access_rule: At most one ordinary retry per failed URL; no bypass of authentication, robots or access controls. Record403/404/timeouts/non-PDF redirects and proceed in queue.

contamination_controls: No fresh-source browsing before freeze receipt.
No evaluation implementation edits in this owned directory.
No source selection using model outputs; freeze source manifest before model execution.
No paid parser/model calls by collector.
Any post-freeze correction preserves original source bytes and change history.
